local NIL, VOID, UNINIT = {tag='nil'}, {tag='void'}, {tag='uninitialized'}
local symbols = {}
local function symbol(s)
    if not symbols[s] then
        symbols[s]={tag='symbol', name=s}
    end
    return symbols[s]
end
local function pair(a, b)
    return {tag='pair', car=a, cdr=b}
end
local function kind(v, t)
    return type(v)=='table' and v.tag==t
end
local function list(a, tail)
    local v=tail
    if v==nil then
        v=NIL
    end
    for i=#a, 1, -1 do
        v=pair(a[i], v)
    end
    return v
end
local function items(v)
    local a={}
    while kind(v, 'pair') do
        a[#a+1]=v.car
        v=v.cdr
    end
    if v==NIL then
        return a
    end
end
local function slice(a, first, last)
    local b={}
    for i=first, last or #a do
        b[#b+1]=a[i]
    end
    return b
end
local function repr(v, quoted)
    if quoted==nil then
        quoted=true
    end
    if v==NIL then
        return '()'
    elseif v==VOID then
        return '#<void>'
    elseif type(v)=='boolean' then
        return v and '#t' or '#f'
    elseif type(v)=='number' then
        return string.format('%d', v)
    elseif type(v)=='string' then
        if not quoted then
            return v
        end
        return '"'..v:gsub('\\', '\\\\'):gsub('"', '\\"'):gsub('\n', '\\n')..'"'
    elseif v.tag=='symbol' then
        return v.name
    elseif v.tag=='procedure' then
        return v.name and '#<procedure '..v.name..'>' or '#<procedure>'
    end
    local a={}
    while kind(v, 'pair') do
        a[#a+1]=repr(v.car, quoted)
        v=v.cdr
    end
    if v~=NIL then
        a[#a+1]='.'
        a[#a+1]=repr(v, quoted)
    end
    return '('..table.concat(a, ' ')..')'
end
local function equal(a, b, deep)
    if deep and kind(a, 'pair') and kind(b, 'pair') then
        return equal(a.car, b.car, true) and equal(a.cdr, b.cdr, true)
    end
    return a==b
end
local function fail(s)
    error(s, 0)
end
local function env(parent)
    return {parent=parent, frame={}}
end
local function find(e, n)
    while e do
        if e.frame[n]~=nil then
            return e
        end
        e=e.parent
    end
    fail('unbound variable: '..n)
end
local function lookup(e, n)
    local v=find(e, n).frame[n]
    if v==UNINIT then
        fail('uninitialized variable: '..n)
    end
    return v
end
local evaluate, call
local function body(a, e)
    local v=VOID
    for _, x in ipairs(a) do
        v=evaluate(x, e)
    end
    return v
end
local function parameters(v)
    local names, seen={}, {}
    while kind(v, 'pair') do
        if not kind(v.car, 'symbol') or seen[v.car.name] then
            return nil
        end
        names[#names+1]=v.car.name
        seen[v.car.name]=true
        v=v.cdr
    end
    if v==NIL then
        return {names=names}
    end
    if not kind(v, 'symbol') or seen[v.name] then
        return nil
    end
    return {names=names, rest=v.name}
end
local function closure(p, b, e, name)
    return {tag='procedure', name=name, min=#p.names, rest=p.rest, params=p.names, body=b, env=e}
end
local function shape(ok, x)
    if not ok then
        fail('bad syntax: '..repr(x))
    end
end
local function bindings(v, unique)
    local a=items(v)
    if not a then
        return nil
    end
    local bs, seen={}, {}
    for _, x in ipairs(a) do
        local b=items(x)
        if not b or #b~=2 or not kind(b[1], 'symbol') or unique and seen[b[1].name] then
            return nil
        end
        bs[#bs+1]={b[1].name, b[2]}
        seen[b[1].name]=true
    end
    return bs
end
call=function(p, a)
    if #a<p.min or not p.rest and #a~=p.min then
        fail((p.name or 'lambda')..': wrong number of arguments (expected '..(p.rest and 'at least ' or '')..p.min..', got '..#a..')')
    end
    if p.fn then
        return p.fn(a)
    end
    local e=env(p.env)
    for i, n in ipairs(p.params) do
        e.frame[n]=a[i]
    end
    if p.rest then
        e.frame[p.rest]=list(slice(a, p.min+1))
    end
    return body(p.body, e)
end
evaluate=function(x, e)
    if kind(x, 'symbol') then
        return lookup(e, x.name)
    end
    if not kind(x, 'pair') then
        shape(x~=NIL, x)
        return x
    end
    local a=items(x)
    shape(a, x)
    local n, h=#a, kind(a[1], 'symbol') and a[1].name or ''
    if h=='quote' then
        shape(n==2, x)
        return a[2]
    elseif h=='if' then
        shape(n==3 or n==4, x)
        if evaluate(a[2], e)~=false then
            return evaluate(a[3], e)
        elseif n==4 then
            return evaluate(a[4], e)
        else
            return VOID
        end
    elseif h=='begin' then
        return body(slice(a, 2), e)
    elseif h=='lambda' then
        local p=n>=3 and parameters(a[2])
        shape(p, x)
        return closure(p, slice(a, 3), e)
    elseif h=='define' then
        if kind(a[2], 'symbol') then
            shape(n==3, x)
            local v=evaluate(a[3], e)
            if kind(v, 'procedure') and not v.fn and not v.name then
                v.name=a[2].name
            end
            e.frame[a[2].name]=v
        else
            local t=a[2]
            local p=n>=3 and kind(t, 'pair') and kind(t.car, 'symbol') and parameters(t.cdr)
            shape(p, x)
            e.frame[t.car.name]=closure(p, slice(a, 3), e, t.car.name)
        end
        return VOID
    elseif h=='set!' then
        shape(n==3 and kind(a[2], 'symbol'), x)
        local v=evaluate(a[3], e)
        find(e, a[2].name).frame[a[2].name]=v
        return VOID
    elseif h=='let' or h=='let*' or h=='letrec' then
        local named=h=='let' and kind(a[2], 'symbol')
        local at=named and 3 or 2
        local bs=n>=at+1 and bindings(a[at], h~='let*')
        shape(bs, x)
        local scope=env(e)
        if h=='let*' then
            if #bs>0 then
                scope=e
            end
            for _, b in ipairs(bs) do
                local v=evaluate(b[2], scope)
                scope=env(scope)
                scope.frame[b[1]]=v
            end
        elseif h=='letrec' then
            for _, b in ipairs(bs) do
                scope.frame[b[1]]=UNINIT
            end
            for _, b in ipairs(bs) do
                scope.frame[b[1]]=evaluate(b[2], scope)
            end
        else
            local vs={}
            for _, b in ipairs(bs) do
                vs[#vs+1]=evaluate(b[2], e)
            end
            if named then
                local names={}
                for _, b in ipairs(bs) do
                    names[#names+1]=b[1]
                end
                local p=closure({names=names}, slice(a, 4), scope, a[2].name)
                scope.frame[a[2].name]=p
                return call(p, vs)
            end
            for i, b in ipairs(bs) do
                scope.frame[b[1]]=vs[i]
            end
        end
        return body(slice(a, at+1), scope)
    elseif h=='cond' then
        local cs={}
        for i=2, n do
            local c=items(a[i])
            shape(c and #c>0, x)
            if c[1]==symbol('else') then
                shape(#c>=2 and i==n, x)
            end
            cs[#cs+1]=c
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(cs) do
            if c[1]==symbol('else') then
                return body(slice(c, 2), e)
            end
            local v=evaluate(c[1], e)
            if v~=false then
                if #c==1 then
                    return v
                else
                    return body(slice(c, 2), e)
                end
            end
        end
        return VOID
    elseif h=='and' then
        local v=true
        for i=2, n do
            v=evaluate(a[i], e)
            if v==false then
                break
            end
        end
        return v
    elseif h=='or' then
        for i=2, n do
            local v=evaluate(a[i], e)
            if v~=false then
                return v
            end
        end
        return false
    elseif h=='when' or h=='unless' then
        shape(n>=3, x)
        if (evaluate(a[2], e)~=false)==(h=='when') then
            return body(slice(a, 3), e)
        end
        return VOID
    end
    local f=evaluate(a[1], e)
    local args={}
    for i=2, n do
        args[#args+1]=evaluate(a[i], e)
    end
    if not kind(f, 'procedure') then
        fail('not a procedure: '..repr(f))
    end
    return call(f, args)
end
local mid=false
local function write(s)
    io.write(s)
    if #s>0 then
        mid=s:sub(-1)~='\n'
    end
end
local function line(s)
    if mid then
        write('\n')
    end
    write(s..'\n')
end
local function global_env()
    local e=env()
    local function add(n, m, r, f)
        e.frame[n]={tag='procedure', name=n, min=m, rest=r, fn=f}
    end
    local function expect(n, v, k)
        local ok=k=='integer' and type(v)=='number' or k=='string' and type(v)=='string' or k=='list' and items(v)~=nil or k=='pair' and kind(v, 'pair') or k=='procedure' and kind(v, 'procedure')
        if not ok then
            fail(n..': expected '..k..', got '..repr(v))
        end
        return v
    end
    for _, name in ipairs{'+', '*', '-', 'quotient', 'remainder', 'modulo', 'abs', 'min', 'max', 'gcd', '=', '<', '>', '<=', '>='} do
        local fixed=(name=='quotient' or name=='remainder' or name=='modulo') and 2 or name=='abs' and 1 or nil
        add(name, fixed or ((name=='+' or name=='*' or name=='gcd') and 0 or 1), not fixed, function(a)
            for _, v in ipairs(a) do
                expect(name, v, 'integer')
            end
            if name=='+' or name=='*' then
                local v=name=='+' and 0 or 1
                for _, x in ipairs(a) do
                    if name=='+' then
                        v=v+x
                    else
                        v=v*x
                    end
                end
                return v
            elseif name=='-' then
                local v=a[1]
                if #a==1 then
                    return -v
                end
                for i=2, #a do
                    v=v-a[i]
                end
                return v
            elseif name=='abs' then
                return math.abs(a[1])
            elseif name=='min' then
                return math.min(table.unpack(a))
            elseif name=='max' then
                return math.max(table.unpack(a))
            elseif name=='gcd' then
                local g=0
                for _, v in ipairs(a) do
                    v=math.abs(v)
                    while v~=0 do
                        g, v=v, g%v
                    end
                end
                return g
            elseif name=='quotient' or name=='remainder' or name=='modulo' then
                if a[2]==0 then
                    fail(name..': division by zero')
                end
                local q=math.floor(math.abs(a[1])/math.abs(a[2]))
                if (a[1]<0)~=(a[2]<0) then
                    q=-q
                end
                if name=='quotient' then
                    return q
                elseif name=='remainder' then
                    return a[1]-a[2]*q
                else
                    return a[1]%a[2]
                end
            end
            for i=2, #a do
                local u, v=a[i-1], a[i]
                local ok=name=='=' and u==v or name=='<' and u<v or name=='>' and u>v or name=='<=' and u<=v or name=='>=' and u>=v
                if not ok then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end)
    end
    add('not', 1, false, function(a)
        return a[1]==false
    end)
    add('eq?', 2, false, function(a)
        return equal(a[1], a[2])
    end)
    add('equal?', 2, false, function(a)
        return equal(a[1], a[2], true)
    end)
    for _, name in ipairs{'null?', 'pair?', 'list?', 'number?', 'symbol?', 'procedure?'} do
        add(name, 1, false, function(a)
            local v=a[1]
            return name=='null?' and v==NIL or name=='pair?' and kind(v, 'pair') or name=='list?' and items(v)~=nil or name=='number?' and type(v)=='number' or name=='symbol?' and kind(v, 'symbol') or name=='procedure?' and kind(v, 'procedure')
        end)
    end
    add('cons', 2, false, function(a)
        return pair(a[1], a[2])
    end)
    add('list', 0, true, list)
    for _, name in ipairs{'car', 'cdr', 'cadr'} do
        add(name, 1, false, function(a)
            local p=expect(name, a[1], 'pair')
            if name=='car' then
                return p.car
            elseif name=='cdr' then
                return p.cdr
            end
            return expect(name, p.cdr, 'pair').car
        end)
    end
    for _, name in ipairs{'length', 'reverse', 'list-ref'} do
        add(name, name=='list-ref' and 2 or 1, false, function(a)
            local ls=items(expect(name, a[1], 'list'))
            if name=='length' then
                return #ls
            elseif name=='reverse' then
                local v=NIL
                for _, x in ipairs(ls) do
                    v=pair(x, v)
                end
                return v
            end
            local k=expect(name, a[2], 'integer')
            if k<0 or k>=#ls then
                fail('list-ref: index out of range: '..string.format('%d', k))
            end
            return ls[k+1]
        end)
    end
    add('append', 0, true, function(a)
        if #a==0 then
            return NIL
        end
        local z={}
        for i=1, #a-1 do
            for _, v in ipairs(items(expect('append', a[i], 'list'))) do
                z[#z+1]=v
            end
        end
        return list(z, a[#a])
    end)
    for _, name in ipairs{'map', 'filter', 'fold-left', 'apply'} do
        add(name, name=='fold-left' and 3 or 2, name~='filter', function(a)
            local f=expect(name, a[1], 'procedure')
            if name=='apply' then
                local z=slice(a, 2, #a-1)
                for _, v in ipairs(items(expect(name, a[#a], 'list'))) do
                    z[#z+1]=v
                end
                return call(f, z)
            end
            local ls={}
            local count=math.huge
            for i=(name=='fold-left' and 3 or 2), #a do
                local z=items(expect(name, a[i], 'list'))
                ls[#ls+1]=z
                count=math.min(count, #z)
            end
            local result, acc={}, a[2]
            for i=1, count do
                if name=='filter' then
                    if call(f, {ls[1][i]})~=false then
                        result[#result+1]=ls[1][i]
                    end
                else
                    local z={}
                    if name=='fold-left' then
                        z[1]=acc
                    end
                    for _, l in ipairs(ls) do
                        z[#z+1]=l[i]
                    end
                    local v=call(f, z)
                    if name=='map' then
                        result[#result+1]=v
                    else
                        acc=v
                    end
                end
            end
            if name=='fold-left' then
                return acc
            end
            return list(result)
        end)
    end
    add('string-append', 0, true, function(a)
        for _, v in ipairs(a) do
            expect('string-append', v, 'string')
        end
        return table.concat(a)
    end)
    add('number->string', 1, false, function(a)
        return string.format('%d', expect('number->string', a[1], 'integer'))
    end)
    add('display', 1, false, function(a)
        write(repr(a[1], false))
        return VOID
    end)
    add('newline', 0, false, function()
        write('\n')
        return VOID
    end)
    add('error', 1, true, function(a)
        local s=expect('error', a[1], 'string')
        for i=2, #a do
            s=s..' '..repr(a[i])
        end
        fail(s)
    end)
    return e
end
local lines={}
for s in io.lines() do
    if s=='(exit)' then
        break
    end
    lines[#lines+1]=s
end
local row, col=1, 1
local function skip()
    row=row+1
    col=1
end
local function at_end()
    while row<=#lines do
        local s=lines[row]
        while s:sub(col, col)==' ' do
            col=col+1
        end
        if col<=#s and s:sub(col, col)~=';' then
            return false
        end
        skip()
    end
    return true
end
local function token()
    if at_end() then
        fail('unexpected end of input')
    end
    local s=lines[row]
    local c=s:sub(col, col)
    col=col+1
    if c=='(' or c==')' or c=="'" then
        return c
    end
    if c=='"' then
        local v=''
        while col<=#s do
            c=s:sub(col, col)
            col=col+1
            if c=='"' then
                return 'v', v
            end
            if c=='\\' then
                if col>#s then
                    break
                end
                c=s:sub(col, col)
                col=col+1
                if c~='"' and c~='\\' and c~='n' then
                    fail('bad escape')
                end
                if c=='n' then
                    c='\n'
                end
            end
            v=v..c
        end
        fail('unterminated string')
    end
    local first=col-1
    while col<=#s and not (" ()'\";"):find(s:sub(col, col), 1, true) do
        col=col+1
    end
    local a=s:sub(first, col-1)
    if a=='.' then
        return '.'
    elseif a:match('^[+-]?%d+$') then
        return 'v', tonumber(a)
    elseif a=='#t' then
        return 'v', true
    elseif a=='#f' then
        return 'v', false
    elseif a:sub(1, 1)=='#' then
        fail('bad token: '..a)
    end
    return 'v', symbol(a)
end
local datum
local function from(t, v)
    if t=='v' then
        return v
    elseif t=="'" then
        return list{symbol('quote'), datum()}
    elseif t~='(' then
        fail('unexpected '..t)
    end
    local a={}
    while true do
        local k, v=token()
        if k==')' then
            return list(a)
        end
        if k=='.' and #a>0 then
            local tail=datum()
            if token()~=')' then
                fail('expected )')
            end
            return list(a, tail)
        end
        a[#a+1]=from(k, v)
    end
end
datum=function()
    return from(token())
end
local global=global_env()
while not at_end() do
    local ok, x=pcall(datum)
    if not ok then
        line('Error: read: '..x)
        if x=='unexpected end of input' then
            break
        end
        skip()
    else
        local success, v=pcall(evaluate, x, global)
        if not success then
            line('Error: '..v)
        elseif v~=VOID then
            line(repr(v))
        end
    end
end
if mid then
    write('\n')
end
